name: ModelVariant174_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant174_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (a spinning grid glows at one of the slot's parts while ribbons leave it one after another, fly towards the other slot and fade, a screen flash fades out and each ribbon then throws out a ring of tumbling sparks); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request modulo 100, seeds the ribbons, grid and sparks, packs four texture words and prints the work size, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 4 while the ribbons leave, 1 once after the last, then 2 when the sparks end; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French header-191 and 321 images build the same source with VERSION_FRENCH and the PAL flash height, without the work-size printf, and bind its data names 0x24 lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
